name: together-dedicated
description: Deploy a model Together AI already serves onto a dedicated endpoint: `machine acquire --provider together` renders the one service.start below into the service's endpoint request, and what comes back is an OpenAI-compatible endpoint on https://api-inference.together.ai/v1 rather than a host. The model is yours to declare: replace the SET-ME placeholder with a catalogue model id, or the id GET /v1/models lists for a model you uploaded with `tg` (uploading is not the acquisition's job). The hardware configuration is named outright in "together.hardware" (an id from GET /v1/hardware); the service publishes no complete list to select from, so requires_gpu.min_vram_gb is judged after the fact from that id. No requires_ports, no requires_disk, no engine arguments: the engine is the platform's, and a profile declaring any of these is refused by name. The lease rides in the endpoint's display_name; the pod verbs (apply, logs, exec, cp, port-forward) do not apply to such a machine and say so.
